verdict.rationale: Asking a managed platform that processes customer task payloads about its AI-training data policy is a fair privacy question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no training opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no data-use policy. Self-hosting (full infrastructure control) and the paid BAA for PHI are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented guarantee against model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
